name: DuckDB
description: A DuckDB database file on this computer: read-only queries with row, memory and time limits; changes wait for approval.

x-card.description: A DuckDB database file on this computer. Read-only queries; changes wait for approval.

file.title: Database file
file.description: An absolute path or ~/…, such as ~/projects/analytics/warehouse.duckdb. Only you choose the file: an AI import can't.

dataFolders.title: Data folders
dataFolders.description: Folders whose Parquet, CSV and JSON files queries may read with read_parquet, read_csv and read_json, such as ~/projects/analytics/data. Empty: queries read only the database file. Only you choose them: an AI import can't.

options.title: Limits
options.description: Rows, time, memory and threads of each call. Policies can tighten rows and time per environment.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Rows a query returns at most; the environment's row limit still applies

statementTimeoutMs.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeoutMs.description: GateRook stops slower statements. Empty: the environment policy.

memoryLimitMb.title: Memory limit
memoryLimitMb.description: Memory DuckDB may use for one call. A query that needs more fails: nothing spills to disk.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Threads DuckDB may use for one call

tools.name: duckdb_query
tools.title: Run a read-only query
tools.description: Runs one read-only statement on the DuckDB database file: SELECT, WITH … SELECT, FROM …, VALUES, TABLE, PIVOT, UNPIVOT, DESCRIBE, SHOW, SUMMARIZE or EXPLAIN. DuckDB opens the file read-only, with external access off and its settings locked, and the call has row, memory and time limits. read_parquet, read_csv, read_json, read_text, read_blob and glob read only absolute paths inside the connection's data folders (current_setting('allowed_directories') lists them). ATTACH, COPY, EXPORT, INSTALL, LOAD, SET, PRAGMA, CALL, transactions and SQL run from text (query()) are refused.

limit.description: Max rows; the connection and the endpoint cap it

tools.name: duckdb_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: The tables and views of the database file by schema: kind, estimated rows, number of columns and comment.

schema.description: Only this schema, for example main

like.description: Only names matching this ILIKE pattern, for example sales_%

tools.name: duckdb_describe_table
tools.title: Describe table
tools.description: The columns of one table or view with their types, nullability, defaults and comments, its primary key, constraints and indexes, and its CREATE statement.

schema.description: The schema; needed when several schemas have a table of that name

tools.name: duckdb_execute
tools.title: Change the database
tools.description: Runs one INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL statement (CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE, COMMENT ON) on the database file, only after a person approved exactly this statement. DuckDB runs it as one transaction on its own read-write instance, with external access off and its settings locked. COPY, ATTACH, EXPORT, secrets, temporary objects and statements that change data inside a query are refused. A change is never retried.

sql.description: One INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL statement. A person approves the exact text.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
